how we got here

Our story

last October

How we met

We were introduced by a mutual friend — Pranav, thank you for that one. 😝 We didn't talk much at first, but I already knew I wanted to date you. 🥰 Every evening with you felt good, and I remember that exact feeling of excitement getting home just so I could talk to you.

the first date

Scooty rides and coffee

Nothing fancy — just a scooty ride and coffee after. 😘 And somehow it's still the best coffee I've ever had.

a favorite memory

The Spider-Man nap

We went to watch Spider-Man and you fell asleep halfway through. 😝 I ended up watching you more than the movie — you looked so cute sleeping there, I didn't mind one bit.

today

Right now

I'm the happiest I've been, dating you. 🥰 I already know I want to marry you one day and travel the world together. 😘 We're already a cool couple — but we're only getting cooler from here.
